scoring_justification: Tc values cannot be recomputed efficiently in the verifier sandbox, so we compare the agent's reported Tc values to paper-derived gold values with tolerance and verify the expected monotonic trend.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold Tc values for b0 points extracted from the paper's Figure 3 middle panel (k_F s)^2=0.23
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figure 3, middle panel; values read from the figure.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manually extracted from the published figure by reading data points at the listed b0 values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The values are the paper's reported result, obtained directly from the published figure.

outputs.description: Superconducting critical temperature Tc as a function of the reduced bulk modulus b0 for lithium with (k_F s)^2 = 0.23. The file must contain at least the rows for b0 = -0.2, -0.1, 0.0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares the submitted Tc values against reference values with a tolerance. All required b0 points must be present and satisfy the stability condition b0 > -0.23.

steps.description: Compare Tc values at required b0 points to gold and check monotonic trend.
